ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the picture is a food web, in which Coyote can be seen in the upper left, Rabbit in the middle, Meadow Grasses at the bottom, and Hawk, Vole, Deer, etc. are also in the picture. In the picture there is an arrow from Rabbit pointing to Coyote. Then reason: in a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, that is, the arrow points from prey to predator. Because Rabbit’s arrow points to Coyote, coyotes eat rabbit.
